title: A Hummingbird Dives at 385 Body Lengths a Second, Faster Than a Jet

scenes.text: A hummingbird dives faster than a fighter jet, for its size.
Researchers filmed male Anna's hummingbirds in courtship dives with six high-speed cameras.
At the bottom, a bird about seven centimetres long covers 385 body lengths every second.
A fighter jet manages about 150. The space shuttle re-entering, about 207.
Then it pulls out at about nine times gravity. Fighter pilots black out around seven.
A fighter jet, beaten by a bird that fits in your hand.

description:
A hummingbird dives faster than a fighter jet, measured in body lengths per second.
Male Anna's hummingbirds reach 385 body lengths per second in courtship dives and pull about nine g at the bottom, more than fighter pilots can take before blacking out.
Which animal do you think is the fastest for its size? Comment below.
first_comment: Peregrine falcons are faster overall, but not for their size. Which would you rather race, a falcon or a hummingbird?
